text:
Maya Chen: Heads up — WellSpring signed PO 44500 but legal pushed back with MSA + DPA redlines asking for KMS attestation and extended data residency notes. They want seats tomorrow to start POC. Can we move?
Priya Kapoor: We can allow a constrained POC if they sign the Order Form (OF) now and accept a 14-day cure period for DPA. No KMS attestation in OF — that's an addendum. Include 'POC provisioning limited' language.
Hannah Wu: Finance needs clarity: can we bill on OF signature alone?
FinanceBot: Billing policy: initial invoice allowed with signed OF + customer PO. Must include clause: 'Initial provisioning and invoice are subject to DPA execution within 14 days; non-execution will pause further provisioning and billing.'
Lucas Reed: Ops note — sandbox-only credentials for POC until DPA final. No long-term key issuance.
Priya Kapoor: Legal requires Appendix A with WellSpring redlines attached and a POC SLA carveout (30 days, 95% uptime). I'll approve once Appendix A is in envelope. Also require exec waiver for any KMS commitment.
Maya Chen: Customer OK with vendor-first signing. Hannah, can you set envelope vendor-first and add Appendix A?
Hannah Wu: Setting DocuSign vendor-first. Envelope created at 3241590024 — https://docusign.com/envelope/ws-44500. Routing: contracts@redwood.com -> legal@wellspring.com -> ops@wellspring.com. Appendix attached. :white_check_mark:
Maya Chen: WellSpring (via ops@wellspring.com): we'll sign vendor-first. KMS attestation ETA 8 business days. Exec contact is ceo@wellspring.com.
Priya Kapoor: Approved: one-time POC SLA noted in OF. Adding phrasing: 'Provisioning limited to POC environment; full production access contingent on executed DPA and KMS addendum.'
Hannah Wu: Envelope completed at 3241590028. DocuSign status: signed by vendor, awaiting customer signers.
Maya Chen: Summary for tracker: PO 44500, envelope ws-44500, vendor-first OF signed, sandbox POC provisioning allowed pending DPA within 14 days, billing caveat included. I'll monitor DPA by 2026-04-18 and escalate if not returned.
FinanceBot: Noted — AR flagged if DPA not executed within 14 days.
Priya Kapoor: Thanks team. I'll sign once final appendix is verified.
WellSpring (ops): will upload final DPA redlines in 24 hours. Thanks.
